verdict.summary: The documentation-only correction accurately reconciles the design record with the census implementation that actually merged. The stated payload shape, total fold into the bounded `unspecified` row, producer-side omission of wire index 0, decoder behavior, routing treatment of `UNSPECIFIED`, and cited self-test coverage all match the checked-in code. It also preserves the important caveat that a dropped declaration is observationally indistinguishable from no signal, without claiming a behavior change. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is introduced.
